narration.text: Struggling to make YouTube Shorts quickly? Today, it is Pictory versus InVideo! Which AI video editor dominates for rapid-fire short-form content?

Round one, Script to Video! Pictory takes your text and crafts an entire video automatically. InVideo requires you to upload your script before its AI gets to work. No contest here! Pictory takes the point!

Next up, Stock Media! Pictory has a good library, but some premium content costs extra. InVideo, however, boasts an excellent free, royalty-free stock media selection. Ouch, that one hurts Pictory! InVideo wins this round!

And finally, Ease of Use! Pictory is intuitive, getting you from script to Short in minutes. InVideo offers more features, but it is a steeper learning curve for beginners. Pictory zooms ahead, winning this round!

So, the verdict is in! Pictory wins for rapid Shorts creation, ideal for beginners. InVideo is better for those needing more editing control and customisation. Which AI editor would you pick? Let us know in the comments, and follow for daily AI battles!
